name: emberserve-pos
description: EmberServe POS — a real-time restaurant operating system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c saffron,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@emberserve/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@emberserve/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@emberserve/shared && npm run build --workspace=@emberserve/api && npm run build --workspace=@emberserve/web
